## Problem

What user or maintainer problem should this solve?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful change. If it belongs to a later roadmap stage, say
which one.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you consider, and why is this preferable?

## Evidence or examples

Include representative public metadata, fixture shapes, or commands with secrets
removed.

## Scope and security

- [ ] This is consistent with the current stage, or explains why an extension point is
  needed now.
- [ ] This does not execute repository code, install model dependencies, or download
  weights without a security review.
- [ ] I have read docs/roadmap.md and docs/threat-model.md.
